children: RNS Number : 7500T  Union Jack Oil PLC  08 September 2026

Union Jack Oil plc (AIM: UJO) is pleased to announce the appointment of Zeus Capital Limited ("Zeus") as Joint Broker with immediate effect. Zeus will work alongside the Company's Nominated Adviser and existing Broker, SP Angel Corporate Finance LLP.
